title: Uninvestment Check
concept: A quick check to tell the difference between someone needing space (still invested) and someone who may be pulling away — so you know which repair to reach for. Describe what you can see, not what you think it means.
whenToUse: When warmth is missing even in ordinary moments, repairs feel like going through the motions, you’ve stopped planning ahead together, or contempt has replaced frustration.
steps: Each of you marks, on your own, which of the 8 signs below you’ve noticed, then share. Describe behaviour you’ve seen — don’t claim to know the other person’s intent.
If contempt is one of your signs, skip the count: contempt means stop and get outside support first. The same goes for fear or coercion at any count.
0–2 signs → likely needs space. Stick to Pause + Return and small repairs.
3 or more signs → may be pulling away. Book a Full Recovery within a week and set proof. Don’t just wait it out. (A specific breach of trust goes to Trust Recovery instead.)
Set a time window to check if things are actually reinvesting.

phrases.text: I’m noticing some distance — do you just need space, or is something bigger going on?
I need a Full Recovery conversation; hope isn’t a plan.
Contempt means we can’t just carry on as normal.

working: Signs: fewer messages, only talking logistics, repairs feeling routine. The couple books a Full Recovery within a week, and agrees to see and review daily check-ins plus evening check-ins at a weekly check-in, for 21 days. Things get clearer.
notWorking: Waiting for “them to miss me” while contempt keeps growing. Hoping instead of actually scheduling something just runs out the clock.
activity: The 8 signs — each of you marks, on your own: (1) fewer non-logistical check-ins, (2) less curiosity about each other, (3) avoiding future plans, (4) doing more on your own in place of shared time (time apart is healthy), (5) mostly practical conversations, (6) going-through-the-motions affection, (7) repairs that feel routine, (8) contempt instead of frustration. If contempt is one of your signs, skip the count: contempt means stop and get outside support first. Otherwise count them: 0–2 = likely needs space; 3 or more = may be pulling away — book a Full Recovery date before you leave the conversation.
warn: If contempt is one of your signs, skip the count: contempt means stop and get outside support first. Fear or coercion at any count: safety and outside support come first.
note: Deciding not to rebuild, or to end the relationship, is a valid outcome of this protocol, not a failure of it.
